{"id":1507021705,"question_id":3455,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1736754341,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"12 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1507021705/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Length of String After Operations","memory":"32 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumLength(string s) {\n        int n = s. length();\n        int hash[26] = {0};\n        if(n <=2)\n        {\n            return n;\n        }\n        for(int i =0 ; i<s.size(); i++)\n        {\n            hash[s[i]-'a']++;\n        }\n\n        int count = 0;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<26 ; i++)\n        {\n            if(hash[i] > 0)\n            {\n                if(hash[i] & 1)\n                {\n                  count += 1;\n                }\n                else\n                {\n                  count += 2;\n                } \n            }  \n        }\n        return count ;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-length-of-string-after-operations","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":155}
